livingCosts.notes: Waterloo Graduate Studies 'Estimated living costs' (single person in Waterloo, OSAP-based, updated annually; monthly figures). Housing = off-campus shared housing incl. utilities $950-$1,900, midpoint $1,425. Food (groceries) $385. Transport $28 (over and above the free UPass). Personal = telephone $106 + entertainment $150 + personal care $80 + clothing $132 + laundry $43 + books and supplies $247 = $758. Months = 8 (fall + winter undergraduate academic year; the page gives monthly figures and a 3-term/12-month graduate year). One-time costs (computer, deposit, furniture) excluded.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Applied Science (BASc) in Mechanical Engineering
programmes.notes: Fall 2026 international schedule: Engineering program fee (maximum tuition) term 1A $34,942 + term 1B $34,597 (all engineering programs are co-op). Fees = incidental fees $1,385.62 x 2 + co-op fee $836 x 2 (charged every academic term from 1A). Academic year = fall + winter terms (8 months); the Fall schedule lists both first-year terms (1A/1B or Year 1 rate applies to both). Incidental fees include WUSA health & dental plans, UPass and student services; UHIP (international health insurance) is billed separately and excluded. History from the Fall 2025 and Fall 2024 international schedules.
